newsitem.title: USA: Hilton says needs $3.5 bln for ITT buyout.
newsitem.headline: Hilton says needs $3.5 bln for ITT buyout.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp estimated Friday that it will need about $3.5 billion to buy the outstanding ITT Corp shares and to pay fees and expenses related to its planned takeover.

In its tender offer filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Hilton said it expects to obtain the funds required to complete the deal through capital contributions or advances by the parent company.
The parent company plans to obtain funds from available cash, working capital, existing credit facilities and new borrowings, according to the filing.
